TC-14/S04.title: Existing specs: Save & Extract closes and adds tasks and records medication changes, and a later Generate does not send the notes to the medication extractor again
TC-14/S04.detail: Blocked (local live-model guard, coordinator 2026-10-15): lane A on 43c38a4f (spec-matrix S04,S25) ran all four titles and they passed — encounter-workflow 'Save & Extract persists a model-extracted action item', snf-save-extract 'Save & Extract saves the notes, closes and adds tasks, and keeps a codeword task verbatim', medication-detection 'Save & Extract automatically detects and persists medication changes', medication-tracker 'Generate does not send Save & Extract's notes to the extractor again' — but the last title stores a (mocked) note, and on 43c38a4f the server then starts the billing job by itself: the tripwire listed 1 live billing.suggestBilling and 1 live parsing.classifyAdmissionReason call at 18:00:55 JST (the test does not mock the classifier). Per the coordinator's rule a local run that reached the live model is not used as a verdict and is not re-run. The same requirements are covered without any model call by TC-14/S06 (local, passed: no task extraction after Generate, nothing added twice, one medication event per change) and on dev by S01 / S02 / S05.
